summary: A flurry of activity this week centered on the Disclosure Forum in Washington, where panelists discussed concrete barriers to transparency, including missing scientists and concerns that current disclosure efforts may be stalled. Ex-defense officials confirmed the military remains unable to explain UAP sightings over U.S. bases, while Rep. Luna pushed for immunity protections for a list of whistleblowers willing to come forward. Separately, researcher Avi Loeb reported detecting methane signatures consistent with organisms on the interstellar object 3I/ATLAS, and newly released NOAA emails showed former official Timothy Gallaudet's documented interest in UAP investigations. With an FY2026 NDAA briefing deadline set for June 30, Congress is expected to receive updates on how agencies are handling UAP evaluation and disclosure mandates.
